fusions.name: Falling Fluke
fusions.desc: Brings your tail down edge-first for 32 damage, always as a critical hit, leaving the target 20% easier to wound for 10 seconds and [Slowed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cleaving Wake
fusions.desc: Cuts a wake through the water in a cone 3 tiles long, dealing 8 damage with a 50% chance to leave each enemy [Bleeding] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Logjam
fusions.desc: Fells a dam of timber 4 tiles wide that stands for 10 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Overdue Edge
fusions.desc: After 10 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 35% for your next strike. Once every 10 seconds.
